title: stackfoundry targets (.stackfoundry/targets.json)
description: The repo's target map: every deployable or testable unit, its stack of packs, how it is gated and tested, and how changed paths map to it. Every skill reads its facts from here; no skill restates them.

docsRoot.description: Superseded by docsRoot in .stackfoundry/config.json, which wins; read only when config.json has none (profiles from before config.json).

timezone.description: IANA zone used to date reports (e.g. Europe/Madrid). Empty = the machine's.

ci.description: The CI provider, read by fix-ci and the CI tooling pack.

cli.description: The read-only command that shows a failed run's log (e.g. gh run view <id> --log-failed).

name.description: Short target name used in every skill argument (api, desktop, web, web-ssr).

summary.description: One line: what it is and who uses it.

testPaths.description: Globs of its tests (they count as this target, tests-only).

packs.description: The stack: pack ids, language first.

exposure.description: Who can reach it. Weights security review and threat modelling.

roles.description: Roles enabled for this target (bug-hunter, fix-verifier, test-designer, test-writer, test-reviewer, test-fixer, performance-reviewer, security-reviewer). Absent = all.

webUi.description: True when fix verification needs a browser (dispatch web-fix-verifier).

materialized.description: role -> repo agent name that replaces the generic role agent for this target.

gate.description: Commands that must pass before work on this target is done. Proven once by init.

preconditions.description: What must be true first (a service stopped, Docker running, a build artifact present).

affectedCommand.description: Optional narrower command for an affected run.

covers.description: Source globs the suite exercises. Absent = the target's paths.

shuffle.description: How to run it with a shuffled order and seed, for the assurance gate.

coverage.description: Command that produces a coverage report.

mutation.description: Command that runs the mutation lane, when one exists.

localUrl.description: Where the running app is served locally, for live repros (web-fix-verifier). Starting it is the gate preconditions' business.

benchmarks.description: Set on a benchmark project's target. Read by write-benchmarks, run-benchmarks and the benchmark agents.

harness.description: The tooling pack of the harness (e.g. tooling-benchmarkdotnet).

dryRun.description: Proves the benchmarks run; measures nothing.

run.description: A measured run; <filter> and <runs> placeholders allowed.

compare.description: Compares run directories or a baseline.

preflight.description: Read-only quiet-machine check, when the harness has one.

disposableTarget.description: Load benchmarks: the throwaway database or service they run against. Never a developer's or a shared one.

profile.description: Path of targets/<name>.md, relative to the repo root.

rules.description: Ordered path rules for change-targets; the first match wins over target paths.

specialists.description: Narrow reviewers a change calls in by path or content.

scope.description: Limit the content scan to these globs.

generated.description: Never hand-edited or reviewed; regenerated (also enforced by guards.json).

fullRunTriggers.description: A change here runs every target's full suites (central package versions, shared build props, the test harness).
